description:
Advances: specled.triangulation

In :per_test mode, coverage_closure.ex:571-572 promotes a tagged test to strength "executed" by string-matching the display "FILE :: TEST_NAME" against the reaching-test displays built by CoverageTriangulation.format_test_display/1 (coverage_triangulation.ex:463-467), which renders the runtime test name. TagScanner records test_name: nil whenever the test name is not a binary literal — which is every test generated by the for-comprehension idiom with an interpolated name, since such a name parses to a binary-construction AST node rather than a binary, and test_name_from_args/1 (tag_scanner.ex:269) only matches is_binary. The scanner-side entry therefore renders "path :: " and can never be a member of reaching_tests, so those tests cap at "linked" and "executed" is structurally unreachable for them.

Surfaced while implementing specled_-c5b (TagScanner for-comprehension recursion), verified 2026-08-12 by reading both call sites. c5b resolves the ticketed harm — tagged_tests_cover_missing_tag false positives and the "claimed" cap, both presence-keyed on Map.has_key?(tag_map, cover_id) — but leaves this join gap. It matters for exactly the adopters c5b unblocks: one arming a strength floor of "executed" still trips on for-generated tests that exist, are correctly tagged, and do execute. The nil is pinned as a known limitation by the tag_scanner_test case "an interpolated generated test name is recorded as nil, a literal one verbatim".

Fix directions: (1) match on file plus line instead of file plus name, since the scanner already records test_line and ExUnit test metadata carries :line; (2) reconstruct a literal prefix from the interpolation segments and match by prefix; (3) treat a nil scanner test_name as "any test in this file whose line matches" rather than as an empty-string name. Direction (1) is likely cleanest but needs the reaching-test display to carry a line, which format_test_display/1 does not emit today.
title: [BUG] for-generated tests can never reach 'executed' strength — nil test_name breaks the per_test display join
